name: Core Identity Gateway
description: Traefik forward-auth target for module user routes. Verifies a peers.social access token (provider JWKS) or a Core browser session, re-checks the session with the provider profile endpoint on every request, and answers the five X-Peermesh-* identity headers plus the selected module's hop secret. Routes: GET /verify/(publisher|media|podcast)(/operator)?. Adopted from the accepted WO-PMSYS-20261023-235 runtime snapshot, with Podcast added.

capabilities.description: GET /verify/<module>[/operator] on the edge-control network only: 204 with X-Peermesh-Auth-Subject, X-Peermesh-Actor-WebID, X-Peermesh-Tenant-ID, X-Peermesh-Property-ID, X-Peermesh-Roles and X-Module-Secret for that module; 401 (or 403 on a failed CSRF check) otherwise. Modules: publisher, media, podcast.

socialOrigin.description: Identity provider origin. Must be https://peers.social outside fixture mode.

audience.description: Token audience and OAuth client ID. Must equal the tenant ID.

tenantId.description: Answered as X-Peermesh-Tenant-ID. Must equal the audience.

tenantKeyFile.description: File holding the tenant key sent to the provider profile endpoint (at least 32 printable characters).

browserOrigins.description: Comma-separated https origins served by the browser session routes (/_core/auth/*). 1 to 8 origins; peers.social is refused.

publisherHost.description: Publisher's public host name. Distinct from the other module hosts; never peers.social.

mediaHost.description: Media's public host name. Distinct from the other module hosts; never peers.social.

podcastHost.description: Podcast's public host name. Distinct from the other module hosts; never peers.social.

publisherGatewaySecretFile.description: File holding Publisher's hop secret (32 to 1024 printable characters, distinct from every other module's).

mediaGatewaySecretFile.description: File holding Media's hop secret, MEDIA_GATEWAY_SECRET (32 to 1024 printable characters, distinct from every other module's).

podcastGatewaySecretFile.description: File holding Podcast's hop secret, PODCAST_GATEWAY_SECRET (32 to 1024 printable characters, distinct from every other module's).
